title: Brazilian Gratin Casserole
description: A delicious and comforting casserole featuring crispy potatoes and a rich Brazilian-inspired sauce.
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the potatoes.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes, exotic oil, gratin seasoning, crispy onions, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Toss to coat.
Transfer the potato mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix the Brazilian cheese and minced garlic.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the potatoes.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
